minimum_live_probes.purpose: Bind actual aecxhwstatsconfig name, returned module object, module+0x120 payload and bank+0xFE8 holder.
Qualify actual public/core/bank tables and callback targets; join returned data+0xF0 to the named payload.
Join payload+0x38 first grid pointer to supplied cache and retained self+0x18; compare weights to independent sources.

private_capture_scope: Only bounded module/caller/source records on same SP11; no optical or pointer bytes exported.
qualification: Before Start, verify actual loaded code and actual tables; never infer targets from the static candidate alone.
single_use_rules: Fresh identity, one rear Color VideoRecord NV12 3840x2160 Start/Stop, no same-boot retry; CDB detach, task removal and Golden guard on return.
